model.summary: Model favors TB by 5.7 points (69% win chance). Biggest factors: Quarterback rating (TB +2.2), Scoring margin (last 8 games) (TB +0.8), Pass defense EPA allowed/play (recent-weighted) (CAR +0.7). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 42.8 total points (TB 24, CAR 19). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (lowers total 1.9), Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (lowers total 0.9), Divisional game (lowers total 0.8). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
